title: usage counts kept in our own database, nothing leaving the platform

criteria.text: Coming back: members active each week by join week, last 12 weeks
What they use: per day, members per part, at most once per member per part per day
Where they drop off: per week, how many reached each step of sign-up, first follow, first post
Counts only: no member id, email, IP or precise location beside any count; dedupe hashes deleted within 8 days
Nothing leaves: no usage data to an outside service, nothing added to page load
criteria.note: Built in #1268 [V]. Checked: standing guard `[guards F133.5]` in `src/lib/usage/count-use.test.ts`.

criteria.text: One switch: a member with sharing off is never counted; builders never counted
criteria.note: Existing search and map-tap switch (#1268) [V]. Checked: `[guards F133.6]` in `tests/usage-counts-db.test.ts`, which since #1458 also asserts no dedupe key is written for either.

criteria.text: On the dashboard: staff see the three answers; nobody else can read the counts
Counting starts before the first invited cohort arrives
criteria.note: Built: counts arriving in production since 2026-11-12, checked 2026-11-18 (#1456 body, #1458 body) [V as read; not re-run against production today]; the first cohort is the dry run the week of 2026-12-28 (VN-0001, #1437).
